facts.title: Animista - On-Demand CSS Animations Library
facts.description: Animista is a CSS animation library and a place where you can play with a collection of ready-made CSS animations and download only those you will use.
facts.keywords: CSS, animation, library, web, front-end, frontend, development, ux, design, motion, keyframe

research.name: Animista
research.note: Browser playground of CSS keyframe animations you tune live and download as a file containing only the ones you picked.

effects: On-demand builder: tune duration, easing, delay and iteration per animation and generate only its keyframes
Favorites basket downloaded as one custom CSS file of just the chosen animations
